text:
Yara: quick sync  planning a morning-curation nudge tied to the benchmark webinar and the long-form report. aim: live regs, plus clicking through to the long-read post-event. suggestions on send windows and voice?
Tom: keep it short for morning. 2 variants for voice: numbers-led (lead with metrics) vs story-led (single-customer snapshot).
Ivy: segmentation idea: peel cohorts by engagement recency + product signal. high-engagers get numbers-led; low-engagers get story-led. also test from-address: product@redwood vs hello@redwood.
Ben: good call. deliverability note: from-address experiment can affect ISP filtering. keep seed list and ramp.
Yara: timing proposal: NA 8:30am local, EMEA 10:00am local, APAC 9:00am local. single-day sends with local window.
Ivy: segment SQLs for DF (infra/platform cohort):
```
SELECT email FROM users
WHERE role IN ('infra','platform')
  AND last_active > now() - interval '180 days'
  AND unsubscribed = false
  AND email_verified = true
  AND company_tier IN ('mid','enterprise');
```
Ivy: product/pm cohort:
```
SELECT email FROM users
WHERE role = 'product'
  AND last_engagement > now() - interval '90 days'
  AND unsubscribed = false
  AND company_size < 500;
```
Tom: suppression: exclude previous_webinars.opt_outs and partner_contacts, and hard bounces.
Yara: CTA plan: Email 1 -> direct reg (low friction). Email 2 -> story + blog excerpt + reg CTA. Email 3 -> day-of reminder + calendar add. post-event -> full report + replay.
Ben: analytics tags: utm_campaign=curation_morning, utm_medium=email, utm_content={segment}_{voice}. add event markers nl_open, nl_click, nl_register, post_read.
Ivy: experiment matrix: voice variant A (numbers-led) vs B (story-led) within each segment; from-address split only on the infra cohort (50/50) to limit risk. track opens, CTR to reg, and reg->attend conversion.
Tom: deliverability ramp: wave1 8% (seed+small random sample), wave2 33%, wave3 100% over 16 hours. seed list of 100 including internal inboxes and major ISP monitors. set custom return-path and ensure DKIM/SPF aligned.
Yara: subject lines (short):
- numbers-led: "New benchmark: production throughput up 2.6x"
- story-led: "How Maia's team cut inference cost without latency tradeoffs"
Ivy: preheaders: "Join the live walk-through + get the report" vs "See the numbers and the customer story". keep under 100 chars.
Ben: QA: inbox render (Gmail/Outlook/iOS), CTAs verified, calendar .ics for day-of, accessible alt text. preview link to staging when ready.
Ivy: DF counts run scheduled. estimate: infra ~7.5k, product ~22k. will post actuals after pull.
Yara: sales alignment: include dynamic snippet for dedicated customers "Priority demo for Dedicated customers" and tag leads with dedicated_followup=true.
Tom: measurement: primary KPI = reg rate; secondary = post-event report clicks and demo requests. set up a dashboard with cohort breakdowns.
PreviewBot: preview URL: https://preview.redwood.ai/morning-curation/2122223333 (staging). mobile/desktop snapshot attached.
Ivy: timeline: copy draft by Mon noon, creative Tue EOD, DF pulls Wed night, QA Thu, ramp Fri NA/EMEA, APAC Mon local.
Yara: ok locking timeline. one small ask: include one emoji variant for story-led subject to test emotional salience. keep numbers-led emoji-free.
Ben: i'll monitor complaints; throttle if spam > 0.05% first wave.
Tom: i'll set up the A/B in ESP and share the tracking doc.
Ivy: posting segment counts in thread after DF run.
Yara: thanks all. will push newsletter brief to growth board and attach the staging preview when PreviewBot confirms final render.
